data.spec: Additive opt-in local-only feedback-to-cloud flow in isolated NLS/cloud-claude-improvements. GET /api/development returns {enabled, repository, workflow, requests:[{id,text,state,created_at,updated_at,run_url,pr_url,error,...}]}; POST /api/development {id,text} saves a bounded draft idempotently; POST /api/development/{id}/send {fingerprint} explicitly authorizes exact saved text to fixed this repo main workflow_dispatch inputs {request_id,request,expected_base}; uncertain dispatch never automatically retried. POST /api/development/{id}/refresh reconciles read-only GitHub run and PR. New Improve dashboard tab accepts text/browser voice, review then explicit Send to cloud Claude. No ordinary chat interception or purchase/hardware changes. Mac runs no coding worker; cloud workflow generates tested PR without merge. Owner invokes scripts/local_demo.py update --pr N --approve-sha <exact merge sha>; supervisor receives approved code only, health check + rollback code. Env OFFICE_DEVELOPMENT_ENABLED/REPOSITORY/GITHUB_TOKEN opt-in (or installed gh auth), no key copied to model, secret installed in GitHub Actions only.
